text: What meanest thou by all this drove which I met?: Heb. What is all this band to thee?
keep that thou hast unto thyself: Heb. be that to thee that is thine
according as the cattle that goeth before me: Heb. According to the foot of the work, etc.
leave: Heb. set, or place | What needeth it?: Heb. wherefore is this?
EleloheIsrael: that is, God, the God of Israel
